summary_zh: 在 Android 设备上提供类似 SteamOS 的体验，包括 Steam Gaming Mode、完整 Linux 桌面，以及 GOG、Epic Games、Xbox 等商店整合和 Steam VR 等。项目开源，无广告、无遥测，安装需自行下载 APK 和 Linux 运行时。
audience_zh: 适合想在 Android 掌机或手机上运行 Steam 游戏、使用 Linux 桌面和尝试多商店游戏库的用户；需 Android 9 及以上且 GPU 为 Adreno 730 或 8xx 系列，无需 root，其他 GPU 为实验性。

evidence.quote: DroidDeck brings the SteamOS experience to Android: Steam Gaming Mode, full Linux desktop, integration with GOG, Epic Games, Xbox, and other storefronts, Steam VR, and more!
DroidDeck brings the SteamOS experience to Android
1. Android 9 or newer on Adreno 730 or newer, or any 8xx. Adreno 6xx, Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR are experimental. Adreno 710 is currently unsupported. No root needed.
3. Install the [APK](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/releases/download/0.7.1/DroidDeck-0.7.1.apk), install the Linux runtime, press **Play** and sign in to Steam.
